$comment: #95 (madrasah-frontend) and launch copy → the unified vocabulary. Copy only: tokens, components, literals and markup are pr95-map.json. Every row is a draft: the owner's copy decides, and where a row and docs/PRD.md disagree the PRD wins (SPEC-D3-20). Apply the rows in order, each only inside its scope; a longer match comes before a shorter one it contains. The words come from medaris-unified/content/vocabulary.json and content/status-map.json, the rules from medaris-unified/rules.md; the ids cited in rule and openDecision resolve there.

pin.recipe: the recipe in pr95-map.json's pin; tools/design-system/check-map.mjs recomputes it

fields.match: the text to find: a literal, case-sensitive substring unless regex or ignoreCase says otherwise
fields.regex: true: match is a JavaScript regular expression, used to find, never to replace blindly
fields.ignoreCase: true: match regardless of case; keep the case of the first letter you replace
fields.to: the replacement; null = no literal replacement: remove the text, or do what note says
fields.contexts: [{ when, to }]: a matching when wins over to; decide each use (as pr95-map.json does for Badge tone="live")
fields.scope: where the row applies; outside it, leave the text alone
fields.term: the content/vocabulary.json term behind the row
fields.rule: the rules.md rule the row applies
fields.openDecision: the open decision the row waits on; until it is decided the row is non-binding
fields.note: why, or what else changes with the words

contexts.when: the live-now state: a badge or line shown while the session is on
